product.name: Monoprice Mini DisplayPort to DisplayPort Cable - Bidirectional 32AWG Sheilded Gold Plated 3ft White
product.description: Connect your DisplayPort® and Mini DisplayPort sources and devices with this bidirectional cable from Monoprice™This cable has a standard-sized DisplayPort (DP) connector on one end and a Mini DisplayPort (MDP) connector on the other. The cable is bidirectional, which means that you can use a DP source with a MDP monitor or a MDP source with a DP monitor.The conductors are made of pure copper, and the connectors are gold plated for improved connectivity and corrosion resistance. Additionally, it is well shielded to prevent stray electromagnetic (EM) and radio frequency (RF) signals from interfering with your data.Important Note! This cable supports DisplayPort version 1.1, which does NOT support audio and has a maximum data transmission rate of 8.64 Gbps. Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. DisplayPort® and the DisplayPort® logo are registered trademarks of the Video Electronics Standards Association.
